qa.question: How many rooms did you visit? Name them.
qa.answer:
How many rooms did you visit? Name them.**
Two places are recorded — hallway_start (which I asserted is the kitchen) and hallway_east_end — but I'd put the honest count at **one room actually visited**, for two reasons. First, my trajectory line lists only hallway_start; hallway_east_end never entered it. Second, my own breadcrumbs never get past x=3.60, while hallway_east_end is anchored at x=4.46 — so I most likely *saw* the east end from a distance and logged it rather than standing in it. So: one corridor/kitchen space, possibly double-counted.

qa.question: Which direction (compass) is the kitchen from your spawn point?
qa.answer:
Which direction (compass) is the kitchen from your spawn point?**
Strictly speaking, the kitchen *is* my spawn point — I spawned in hallway_start and later concluded that this corridor at y≈2.85 was itself the kitchen aisle. If you mean the counter/appliance run that made me call it a kitchen, I reached it by walking in the direction my compass read as roughly 358–0 degrees, from x≈0.4 out to x≈3.6, i.e. along increasing x, which I labelled "east."

I should flag two problems with that answer. My compass frame was never validated against true north, and it is internally inconsistent with my own labels: heading ~0 carried me along +x ("east"), yet I also faced 270 to look at what I called the *south* counter face, and my unexplored-exit list pairs "exit at 0 deg" with the west anchor (0.43, 3.15) and "exit at 270 deg" with the east anchor (4.46, 2.85) — the reverse of what my travel suggests. So treat "east" here as "along +x from spawn," not as a trustworthy cardinal bearing.
